content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML sections.
The test 'test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present' failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, it could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the environment setup and basic file generation worked (3 tests passed), the XML output failed to correctly map and embed the '위험등급' (Risk Level) value from the overview JSON into the HWPX document structure.
